user.title: Select services
user.description: Enter this integration’s own local UniFi credentials. TLS certificates are verified; supply the SHA-256 fingerprint for a self-signed certificate. Setup starts with a preview.

data.work_probe_enabled: Measure Microsoft 365 connectivity from the house
data.wifi_history_enabled: Store all-client Wi-Fi history every 30 minutes (local)
data.unifi_api_key: Local UniFi API key (leave empty to keep existing)

sources.title: Select destinations
sources.description: Separate values with commas. SAP requires documented destination prefixes for your services.

routes.title: Bind existing routes
routes.description: Bind each service to a separate existing IP route. WAN, device scope and enabled state are preserved. Services: {services}

network.title: Internet connections
network.description: Select the gateway. WAN1 and WAN2 are observed independently. Missing values remain unknown; availability over a measurement window does not prove current connectivity.

data.gateway_observer_enabled: Observe IPv4/IPv6 on the gateway (restricted SSH access)
data.ipv6_actor_enabled: Inspect the managed IPv6 policy with a separate key
data.ipv6_actor_active: Activate HA as the sole IPv6 policy writer

gateway_observer.title: Gateway observations
gateway_observer.description:
First install the documented gateway observer and authorize only this public key with the forced read-only command:

`{public_key}`

Confirm the Ed25519 host key through an already trusted connection. This integration does not change router rules.

ipv6_actor.title: IPv6 policy access
ipv6_actor.description:
Install the restricted gateway actor and authorize this dedicated public key with the fixed `service-route-sync ipv6 v1` command. Initial setup only inspects; activation requires a separate options change after the old writer is stopped.

`{public_key}`

clients.title: Monitored clients
clients.description: Select UniFi clients. Existing device profiles retain their grouped network adapters. New offline clients must be online for their first selection.

client_probe.title: Client probe access
client_probe.description:
Install the documented client observer with its fixed read-only command and private target configuration. Authorize this dedicated public identity:

`{public_key}`

Verify the gateway host key through an already trusted connection. Setup then validates all selected profiles.

reconfigure.title: Migrate client profiles
reconfigure.description: One-time administrator migration of existing client profiles with stable IDs and MAC groups. The dedicated probe access must already be provisioned and is verified before saving.

monitoring.title: Diagnostic profile
monitoring.description: Select this PC’s network interfaces. Gaming profiles remain separate. New setups start with observation and no notifications. If the PC is offline, enter its known MAC address in the separate field.

data.monitoring_manual_mac: MAC address of an offline PC interface
data.monitoring_maintenance_minutes: Maintenance duration from start of hour (minutes)

monitoring_sources.title: Verify read-only sources

connection.title: UniFi connection
connection.description: Enter this integration’s own local UniFi credentials. TLS certificates are verified; supply the SHA-256 fingerprint for a self-signed certificate. Setup starts with a preview.

data.unifi_api_key: Local UniFi API key (leave empty to keep existing)

ipv6_controls.title: IPv6 controls
ipv6_controls.description: Select five distinct helpers and the three values offered by the selection helper.
